headers.//: Every origin the app actually loads from, measured against the live site: itself for script, style, font and image, plus the Cloud Run API for fetch. Nothing else. 'unsafe-inline' is on style only, because React writes inline style attributes and there are no inline scripts at all. frame-ancestors replaces X-Frame-Options and is the version browsers still honour. NOTE: connect-src names the backend host. Change the Cloud Run URL and the dashboard goes blank with a console error, so change both together.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://amazon-discovery-34n34tq6za-el.a.run.app; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
